pairs.difference: Rasgulla is a spongy ball in light sugar syrup; Rasmalai is a flattened disc soaked in thick saffron milk.
Kheer is made with whole rice and served warm or cold; Phirni is made with ground rice, set and served chilled in clay bowls.
A Jalebi is an Indian orange spiral soaked in sugar syrup; Churros are Spanish ridged sticks rolled in sugar and dipped in chocolate.
A Cupcake is sweet and frosted; a Muffin is unfrosted, denser and counts as breakfast.
A Pancake is flat and smooth, made in a pan; a Waffle has a grid of pockets, made in an iron.
An Ice Gola is shaved ice on a stick drenched in syrup at a street cart; a Milkshake is blended milk and ice cream in a glass.
Mysore Pak is a dense, ghee-rich block; Soan Papdi is flaky and falls apart into threads.
Black Forest is a chocolate cake with cherries and whipped cream; Red Velvet is red with cream-cheese frosting.
Kulfi is dense, not churned, and comes on a stick or in a matka; Ice Cream is churned and airy, in a cone or cup.
Barfi is Indian, milk-based, often with silver foil; Fudge is Western, butter-and-sugar based.
Butterscotch is golden with crunchy caramel bits; Tutti Frutti is multicoloured candied fruit bits.
A Brownie is a dense, fudgy square; a Lava Cake is a small round cake with a molten chocolate centre.
A Doughnut is a fried ring, often glazed; a Cinnamon Roll is a baked spiral with cinnamon and icing.
Cheesecake is creamy on a biscuit base; Tiramisu is layered sponge soaked in coffee.
Falooda has vermicelli, rose syrup and basil seeds in a tall glass; a Sundae is ice cream with sauce and toppings.
A Pastry is a single slice of frosted cream cake; a Swiss Roll is sponge rolled into a spiral with filling.
Shrikhand is thick strained yogurt with saffron, from Gujarat and Maharashtra; Mishti Doi is caramelised set yogurt from Bengal, in a clay pot.
Sandesh is Bengali, made from soft chhena and moulded; Peda is round, made of khoya and has a caramel note.
Gajar Halwa is orange and made from carrots; Moong Dal Halwa is golden and made from lentils.
Mousse is airy, chocolatey and set in a cup; Fruit Salad is chopped fresh fruit, often with custard or ice cream.
Malpua is a sweet pancake soaked in syrup; Gujiya is a fried, stuffed crescent dumpling.
Chocolate melts and is cocoa-based; Toffee is chewy, wrapped and caramel-based.
You lick a Lollipop on a stick; a Gummy Bear is a chewy, fruity, bear-shaped sweet.
Jelly wobbles and is fruity and see-through; Custard is creamy and yellow. In India they're often served together.
You chew Bubble Gum and blow bubbles; Candy Floss is spun sugar on a stick that melts in your mouth.
A Macaron is a pastel almond sandwich with filling; a Cookie is a single baked round, like choc chip.
Meetha Paan is a folded betel leaf with sweet fillings; Mukhwas is coloured seeds you take by the spoonful after a meal.
Kaju Katli is a silver-foiled cashew diamond; Chikki is a crunchy peanut-and-jaggery brittle.
A Ladoo is a dry ball you hold; a Gulab Jamun sits in hot syrup.
